name: Kneaders Hearty Chicken Noodle Soup with Fresh Bakery Roll
whyItWorks: Tender pulled chicken breast, thick egg noodles, and soft cooked carrots in a soothing chicken broth alongside a freshly baked soft white roll. Ideal warm comfort food for sensitive digestive days.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order a cup or bowl of chicken noodle soup with a plain soft white dinner roll. Highly comforting and low-residue.
